visible_objects.description: A horizontal row of plain cells standing for the token indices of the conditioning prompt (no numbers in the cells). It sits along the top of the frame and is the running sequence for the whole video.
visible_objects.label: idx
visible_objects.change: Cells slide in one by one from the left to form the prompt row.

visible_objects.description: A small counter set to the first pass, tied to max_new_tokens.
visible_objects.label: pass 1 / max_new_tokens
visible_objects.change: Fades in beside the right end of idx_row and pulses once to show a pass is starting.

beats.transition: Opens on an empty frame. The idx row builds from left to right, then the counter appears.
beats.framing: idx_row is centred across the upper third, with the loop counter at its right end. The lower two thirds stay empty, ready for the pipeline.
beats.on_screen_text: generate repeats one pass max_new_tokens times.
beats.narration_line: Each pass adds one index to idx.

visible_objects.description: The prompt row. It stays whole and in place, keeping every cell even when the crop window is shown.
visible_objects.label: idx
visible_objects.change: Stays still. Its tail is framed by the crop window, and a copy of the framed cells flows down into the model.

visible_objects.description: Counter on pass 1.
visible_objects.label: pass 1 / max_new_tokens
visible_objects.change: Holds steady, dimmed slightly.

visible_objects.description: First stage chip at the far left of a left-to-right stage track under idx_row. Names the model input.
visible_objects.label: idx_cond
visible_objects.change: Enters first and lights up while the input is formed.

visible_objects.description: A dashed bracket over the tail of idx_row that marks the last block_size cells. It is shown as a conditional case only: for a too-long sequence just the framed cells are copied down as idx_cond, and idx_row itself is not shortened.
visible_objects.label: last block_size if too long
visible_objects.change: Briefly snaps over the tail of idx_row, the framed copy drops down, then the window fades out while idx_row stays fully intact.

visible_objects.description: Second stage chip, a box that takes idx_cond and outputs a grid of logits.
visible_objects.label: self(idx_cond)
visible_objects.change: Lights up as the idx_cond copy enters it. A logits grid comes out on its right.

visible_objects.description: A grid of logits with one row per position of idx_cond. The bottom row is the final position.
visible_objects.change: Comes out of the model box. All rows except the final one slide aside and fade to the background.

visible_objects.description: The single row of logits for the final position, drawn as a row of bar-cells of different heights. It is the data that moves through the rest of the pipeline.
visible_objects.change: Separates from the grid and moves right, then every bar shrinks by the same proportion as it passes the temperature chip, keeping the same order of heights.

visible_objects.description: Third stage chip, marking that only the final position's logits are kept.
visible_objects.label: logits[:, -1, :]
visible_objects.change: Lights up as the final row separates.

visible_objects.description: Fourth stage chip, marking division by temperature.
visible_objects.label: / temperature
visible_objects.change: Lights up as the row passes through and is scaled.

must_show_covered: A row of logits for the final position only, separated from the earlier positions, which are set aside
beats.transition: The tail of idx is framed, and a copy drops down into the newly appearing stage track. Attention moves from the top row into the pipeline.
beats.framing: The stage track runs left to right across the middle of the frame, with idx_row still visible above. Focus follows the data: idx_cond, then the model, the grid, the final row and the temperature chip. Earlier grid rows move off to the side.
beats.narration_line: Keep the final logits, divide by temperature.

visible_objects.description: Prompt row, unchanged.
visible_objects.label: idx
visible_objects.change: Holds, dimmed.

visible_objects.description: Counter on pass 1.
visible_objects.label: pass 1 / max_new_tokens
visible_objects.change: Holds, dimmed.

visible_objects.description: Earlier stage chip, done for this pass.
visible_objects.label: idx_cond
visible_objects.change: Dims.

visible_objects.description: Earlier stage chip, done for this pass.
visible_objects.label: self(idx_cond)

visible_objects.description: Earlier stage chip, done for this pass.

visible_objects.description: Earlier stage chip, done for this pass.
visible_objects.label: / temperature
visible_objects.change: Dims.

visible_objects.description: A fork in the stage track shaped like a gate, with the condition written on it. It splits into an upper true path and a lower false path that join again on the right.
visible_objects.label: top_k is not None
visible_objects.change: Enters and lights up as the scaled logits row reaches it.

visible_objects.description: Upper branch of the gate. On this path the row keeps all of its cells, but every cell below the k-th largest is marked -Inf where it stands, and the k largest stay unchanged.
visible_objects.label: true: below k-th largest → -Inf
visible_objects.change: The row travels along it, and its low cells flip to -Inf markers in place. The number of cells stays the same.

visible_objects.description: Lower bypass branch of the gate. On this path a ghost copy of the same row passes through with no change at all.
visible_objects.label: false: unchanged
visible_objects.change: A ghost copy of the row glides along it with untouched bars, then both paths rejoin.

visible_objects.description: The scaled final-position logits row.
visible_objects.change: Reaches the gate and is shown on both paths at once: filtered on the true path, untouched on the false path.

must_show_covered: The top-k step drawn as a gated branch labeled 'top_k is not None': on the true path, logits below the k-th largest become -Inf; on the false path, the logits pass by untouched
beats.transition: The scaled row moves right from the temperature chip into a fork that opens in the track.
beats.framing: The gate and its two paths fill the centre of the frame. The earlier chips recede to the left and idx_row stays faint above. The condition label stays readable throughout.
beats.on_screen_text: Top-k runs only when top_k is set.
beats.narration_line: Only when top_k is set do low logits become -Inf.

visible_objects.description: Prompt row, unchanged.
visible_objects.label: idx
visible_objects.change: Holds, dimmed.

visible_objects.description: Counter on pass 1.
visible_objects.label: pass 1 / max_new_tokens
visible_objects.change: Holds, dimmed.

visible_objects.description: The top-k fork, already passed. Its condition label stays readable.
visible_objects.label: top_k is not None
visible_objects.change: Dims and recedes to the left, and its path labels fade out.

visible_objects.description: The logits row after the optional top-k step.
visible_objects.change: Moves into the softmax chip and is replaced by probability bars.

visible_objects.description: Stage chip after the gate, turning logits into normalized probabilities.
visible_objects.label: softmax
visible_objects.change: Enters and lights up as the row passes through.

visible_objects.description: A bar chart of normalized probabilities, one bar per index, with clearly different heights.
visible_objects.label: probs
visible_objects.change: The bars grow out of the softmax chip.

visible_objects.description: Stage chip for the random draw from the probabilities.
visible_objects.label: multinomial
visible_objects.change: Lights up while the draw happens.

visible_objects.description: A pointer that sweeps across the bars and lands on one bar at random. It deliberately lands on a bar that is not the tallest.
visible_objects.label: idx_next
visible_objects.change: Sweeps over the bars, settles on a shorter bar, and lifts that one index out as idx_next.

must_show_covered: Probabilities from softmax shown as bars, with multinomial drawing a random pick that is not necessarily the tallest bar
beats.transition: The row leaves the rejoined paths, passes through softmax, and comes out as bars.
beats.framing: The probability bars sit at the centre right, with the softmax and multinomial chips beside them. The tallest bar stays visible so the learner sees the pick was not it.
beats.on_screen_text: A random draw, not always the tallest bar.
beats.narration_line: Softmax makes probabilities; multinomial picks at random.

visible_objects.description: The sampled index idx_next, now a single cell.
visible_objects.label: idx_next
visible_objects.change: Rises from the bars up to the right end of idx_row.

visible_objects.description: Final stage chip, which appends idx_next to the running sequence.
visible_objects.label: torch.cat
visible_objects.change: Enters at the end of the track and lights up as the cell joins idx.
